ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Fasten.cs:40-43) == cost 1 / POWER / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DynamicVar("ExtraBlock", 4m)` (Fasten.cs:38) == `_extra = 4`. `_extra` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` so `magic_number` surfaces it.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<FastenPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["ExtraBlock"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Fasten.cs:47) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, FastenPower, self._extra, applier=ctx.player)`. FastenPower is one of the two C# `ModifyBlockAdditive` implementers the creature_card_cmds seam pins for gap G1, but it self-gates on `IsPoweredCardOrMonsterMoveBlock` (FastenPower.cs:27) so it is on the correct side of that gate; the power's own behaviour is the power stream's.

guards.what: ExtraHoverTips does a live card-pool lookup for a Defend-tagged card (Fasten.cs:17-36)
guards.rationale: The only non-trivial body in the file, and it is pure presentation -- it picks which card to SHOW in the hover tip, falling back to `ModelDb.Card<DefendIronclad>()`. No state is touched and nothing is drawn from any RNG.
